mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, we are looking at 65 degrees with moderate drizzle near Verona City Hall. If you are out tonight, keep an eye on the sky; the International Space Station will make a pass at 7:40 PM, moving from the west southwest near Mount Horeb toward the northeast near Madison, reaching high in the sky for one minute.

The City of Verona has released a report regarding an incident on September 10th where officers were called to Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress involving a firearm. The suspect was taken into custody and faces charges of burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

There is plenty to do this weekend, including the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival today, and live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company also happening today. Tomorrow, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia sessions and a farmers market early next week.

Regarding the recent police report, officers responded to a burglary on September 10th in the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way, where they successfully apprehended a 19-year-old male who was in possession of a handgun at the time.
Today's flavor is Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently open for business and will remain open until their 10 PM closing time tonight.
